label: 2. Okay, the meeting is now in session.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Okay, the meeting is now in session.
We're going to decide what to do this weekend?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: I propose we game.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Something other than that.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: We play video games together every day,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: so there's no need to suggest it.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Still... it's a lotta fun.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: True that.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: How about we go to the Arcade and play Iron Punch?
You just said we couldn't suggest gaming.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: What's important is that we leave the dorm.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Let's go to the Arcade first,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: play all the games there,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: and then...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Okay,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: maybe we can get something to eat?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hm...

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Trony, is there anything specifically that you wanted to do?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Trony?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Are you there?

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Honestly,

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: I'm getting tired just listening to all of these messages.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Let's go out some other time.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: But we haven't finished making plans!
The meeting for the long-awaited 100th commemorative outing
comes to an end like every meeting does, with Trony leaving the group chat.
